sources.title: Poison Cloud
markers: The cloud itself doesn't deal any damage.

summary: A +1 greatclub with Poison Mist, a short-rest weapon action that adds Poison damage and creates a cloud.

fields.Effect: A +1 greatclub that deals 1d8 + 1 Bludgeoning and grants Poison Mist.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Poison Mist: Melee weapon Action once per Short Rest. Requires weapon proficiency. On hit, add Poison damage equal to your proficiency bonus and create a roughly 5 ft-radius Poison Cloud for 3 turns.
fields.Cloud: Creatures in the cloud make a Constitution save each turn against your spell save DC or become Poisoned for 1 turn. The cloud itself deals no damage.
fields.Reported area attacks: The pinned action reports additional attacks against creatures and objects within the cloud radius, including allies. Additional clouds can form at those hits.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 mechanics and pinned item and related rule sources. Completed the item-specific action, timing, save, or effect against pinned evidence.
